questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turn.
No left turn.
No right turn.
No turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: Which of the following are used on some highways to direct drivers into the proper lanes for turning?

options.text: Flashing red lights
Flashing yellow lights
White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of the lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes
questions.explanation: White arrows on the road show which lanes to use for going straight or turning.

questions.question: When a vehicle with an Anti-Lock Braking System starts to lose traction on a slippery road, drivers should:

options.text: Pump the brakes.
Press and hold the brake pedal.
Press and hold the gas pedal.
Lightly tap the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: If your car loses grip on a slippery road, press the brake pedal hard and keep it pressed. Steer away from danger. The Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) will pump the brakes automatically. Do not pump the brakes yourself or the ABS will stop working.

questions.question: You are driving on a busy street and your vehicle's accelerator sticks open. You should:

options.text: Blow your horn.
Slam on your brakes.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Turn off your ignition, taking care not to lock the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off your ignition, taking care not to lock the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, the car will keep going fast even if you lift your foot off the gas. Turn off the engine carefully. Do not turn the key all the way, or the steering wheel will lock. Then press the brakes and pull to the side of the road safely.

questions.question: You may park or stop along the shoulder of the freeway:

options.text: As long as you turn on your four-way flashers.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to look at a map for directions.
Only if you have an emergency.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only if you have an emergency.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on the freeway shoulder unless it is an emergency.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and your vehicle is not equipped with an Anti-Lock Braking System, you should:

options.text: Hold down the brake pedal.
Firmly pump your brakes.
Lightly tap the brakes.
Release the brake pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Firmly pump your brakes.
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop quickly in an emergency. Your car will stop fast and you can still steer.

questions.question: When you approach a railroad crossing without flashing warning signals or crossing gates, you should:

options.text: Cross the tracks immediately and as quickly as possible.
Always stop before crossing the tracks.
Prepare to yield to any train at the crossing.
Speed up to beat any oncoming train.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prepare to yield to any train at the crossing.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to give way to trains before crossing railroad tracks, especially if there are no lights or gates. Do not cross until your entire car can fit on the other side. Do not change gears while crossing because the car might stall.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines dividing the lanes. You may:

options.text: Cross these lines only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross these lines to pass other vehicles if there is no oncoming traffic.
Cross these lines under no circumstances.
Cross these lines only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross these lines only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Two solid yellow lines mean no passing is allowed in either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway and see children playing nearby. Before you start moving, you should:

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Sound your horn so the children hear you.
Walk to the back of the car to check the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of the car to check the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Look through your back window for people and objects. Mirrors alone are not enough, especially with children nearby. Get out and check behind your car before backing up or out of a driveway.

questions.question: A driver should be extra alert to motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians because:

options.text: They're difficult to see in traffic.
They obey different traffic laws than larger motor vehicles.
They always have the right-of-way.
They don't have rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: They're difficult to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen because drivers did not see motorcycles, bicycles, or pedestrians even though they were looking. These are harder to spot because they are smaller, move faster, and have less noticeable lights. Watch carefully for them to prevent crashes.

questions.question: In bad weather, drivers should:

options.text: Drive faster to reach their destination more quickly.
Stay closer to the car ahead.
Stay farther away from the car ahead.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from the car ahead.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time. What should happen?

options.text: The larger vehicle has the right-of-way.
The car on the left has the right-of-way.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two cars arrive at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can then go when it is safe.

questions.question: Roads become very slippery:

options.text: After it rains for an hour or longer.
The day after it rains.
In the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
Right after the rain stops.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are very slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. Rain brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. Hot weather makes this worse because heat and water cause more oil to rise.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. You should:

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot. Always check your mirrors and turn on your signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: Your body processes approximately:

options.text: Three drinks per hour.
One drink per hour.
Two drinks per hour.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: One drink per hour.
questions.explanation: Your body processes about one drink per hour. How impaired you become depends on how much you drink, how fast you drink, your body weight, what you ate, and your health.

questions.question: You should be careful when passing a bicycle because:

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pass the bicycle.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing bicycles because the cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid objects on the road. Always drive carefully around bicyclists.

questions.question: The correct way to use a freeway exit ramp is to:

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down after you enter the exit ramp.
Keep the same speed while on the exit ramp.
Pass slower cars on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you enter the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you are on the exit ramp.

questions.question: Who is responsible for a vehicle's mechanical condition?

options.text: The legal owner.
The mechanic.
The driver.
The insurance company.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver.
questions.explanation: The driver is responsible for the vehicle's condition, even if they do not own it. Perform regular maintenance on your vehicle.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.

options.text: White
Blue
Green
Orange

questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic. They are usually white with black markings and drivers must always obey them.

questions.question: A solid yellow line and a broken yellow line mark the center. The broken line is next to your lane. When can you pass?

options.text: Only in an emergency.
Only on an expressway.
If traffic is clear.
Only at an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: If traffic is clear.
questions.explanation: When you have a broken yellow line next to your lane and a solid yellow line in the other lane, you may pass if no cars are coming toward you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for bicycles.
Bicycles not allowed.
Bicycle repair shop ahead.
Bicycles have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Steep grade ahead.
Winding road.
Merging traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep grade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a steep downhill slope ahead.

questions.question: If an oncoming driver is heading toward you in your lane, you should:

options.text: Blow your horn, steer right, and accelerate.
Blow your horn, steer left, and brake.
Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in the center of your lane, blow your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: Honk your horn to alert the other driver. If they do not move, steer to the right to escape. Do not steer left because the other driver may correct at the last second and you will still crash. Brake firmly and steadily. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the impact.

questions.question: You are coming to an intersection with a flashing yellow light. You should:

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Drive carefully through the intersection.
Prepare to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly and carefully. Look both ways before crossing.

questions.question: You come to an intersection that is blocked by other traffic. You should:

options.text: Go slowly until the traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front of you.
Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through.
Sound your horn to make the cars move up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can pass through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if you cannot drive all the way through it. Wait until traffic clears so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: What is the appropriate action to take when approaching a railroad crossing that does not have signals to direct traffic?

options.text: Always bring the car to a complete stop.
Slow down and be prepared to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals so you will never encounter this situation.
Increase your speed to get across the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down at unmarked railroad crossings and be ready to stop. Look both ways before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait until the train passes.

questions.question: When you park uphill on a street with a curb:

options.text: Keep the front wheel straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels sharply to the left, away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your car will roll toward the curb, not into traffic.

questions.question: At an intersection with a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars tailgating.
Move when the vehicle ahead of you moves.
Look right first, then left, then right again.
Look left first, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left first, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because vehicles from the left are closer to you. Then look right, then left again to catch any vehicles you missed.

questions.question: What color are pavement markings that separate traffic lanes moving in opposite direction?

options.text: Yellow
White
Yellow and white
Yellow, white, and black

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Certain highway signs require drivers to obey an indicated instruction. Such signs are known as:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. You can be penalized for not following them.
